evals.name: Default usecase2 full visualization
evals.prompt: Show me the auGENT architecture visualization. I need an interactive HTML file that shows how the platform framework connects to usecase2.
evals.expected_output: A self-contained HTML file with interactive SVG diagram showing the auGENT framework (Orchestration, Agents, Guardrails, LLM Service, Observability) stacked above the usecase2 pipeline (event_detector -> trigger_classifier -> novelty_classifier -> orch_router, with development and confirmation branches). Dark engineering theme, clickable nodes, hidden edges that reveal on selection, zoom/pan interaction, search box, right sidebar.
assertions: The HTML is fully self-contained with no external CDN or URL references
Contains an SVG element with viewBox='0 0 2700 1200' and explicit width/height
Uses the dark engineering theme (#0B0E14 background, #4D9EFF accent)
All CSS and JavaScript are inline (no external files)
Framework layer includes Orchestrator, GraphBuilder, NodeExecutor, AuGENTAgent, LLMService, EventBus modules
Use case layer includes event_detector, trigger_classifier, novelty_classifier, orch_router nodes on row 1
Use case layer includes context_collector (or context_coll.), analyser, portfolio_mapper (or portfolio_map.), summary_agent, and distributor on row 2
Contains interactive JavaScript for zoom, pan, node selection, and edge visibility
Contains a search/filter input and a collapsible sidebar
Contains zero emoji characters

evals.name: Framework-only visualization without use case
evals.prompt: I just need the auGENT framework layer visualized - the orchestration, agents, guardrails, LLM service, and observability columns. Don't include any use case pipeline.
evals.expected_output: A self-contained HTML with SVG diagram showing only the 5 framework columns. No use case layer, no divider, no pipeline nodes. Dark theme, interactive.
assertions: The HTML is self-contained with no external references
Contains SVG with correct dark theme styling

Framework nodes include Orchestrator, GraphBuilder, AuGENTAgent, AgentExecutor, InputGuard, OutputValidator, ContentSafety, SchemaRegistry, LLMService, AzureOpenAI, EventBus, LangfuseExporter, Metrics
Does NOT contain use case nodes like event_detector, orch_router, context_collector
No use case pipeline section or divider
Contains interactive elements (zoom, selection, sidebar)

evals.name: Full interactivity requirements
evals.prompt: I'm demoing the auGENT platform architecture to our CTO tomorrow. Generate an interactive HTML diagram they can explore - needs zoom and pan, clickable nodes that show details, a search box to find specific modules, and a clean collapsible sidebar.
evals.expected_output: Rich interactive HTML visualization with complete zoom/pan controls, node selection with detail sidebar, edge visibility toggling on node selection, search filtering, and collapsible sidebar. Dark engineering theme.
assertions: The HTML is self-contained with inline CSS and JS
JavaScript includes zoom (scale/transform) and pan (translate) logic
Node selection is implemented with click handlers that update a sidebar
Edge visibility changes on node selection (connected edges become visible)
A search input is present that filters nodes by text matching
A sidebar is present with zoom controls, risk level legend, edge type legend, and detail section
Sidebar can be toggled/collapsed with a hamburger button
Dark theme colors (#0B0E14, #131720, #4D9EFF) are present
No emoji characters used

evals.name: Custom use case pipeline generation
evals.prompt: I'm building a new use case called 'document-intelligence' for auGENT. Its agents are: doc_ingestor, text_extractor, entity_recognizer, summarizer, and report_generator. Generate an architecture diagram with the framework on top and this pipeline below, using the same dark interactive style.
evals.expected_output: Self-contained HTML showing the 5-column framework above a new use case layer with the specified agents (doc_ingestor, text_extractor, entity_recognizer, summarizer, report_generator) connected as a sequential pipeline. Dark theme, interactive.
assertions: The HTML is self-contained with no external references
Framework layer is present with the 5 standard column categories (Orchestration, Agents, Guardrails, LLM Service, Observability)
Use case nodes include doc_ingestor, text_extractor, entity_recognizer, summarizer, report_generator
Pipeline edges connect the custom use case nodes in sequence
Dark interactive theme with zoom, selection, and sidebar
